title: a very normal chess video
summary: Tony plays ordinary 3+0 blitz on chess.com against ~2000-2080 rated humans (e.g. yolver 2073, azazaza7 1982, tiki_taka_ultra 2082) trying to climb 32 rating points in one sitting. He ends by crossing 2100 (~35:05). No variant rules.
win_condition: Reach 2100 blitz rating (meta-goal). If remade: plain blitz game vs a ~2050-2100 bot with 3+0 clock.

board.theme_notes: standard chess.com green board with 3-min clocks

current_impl_issues: Impl maps it to 'roulette' with a hidden twist; the video has no twist at all (title is ironic).
evidence: 0:01 'trying to climb 32 points of rating in one sitting'; 0:05 part two of a rating climb; 35:05 'we do actually cross 2100'. Frame visual_c: standard armies, 3-min clocks, human usernames/ratings.
not_playable_reason: Not a variant: a normal online 3-minute blitz rating climb (part 2), from ~2068 to crossing 2100, against human opponents.
